draft.shortGloss: to visit; to go to see
draft.emotion: friendly and purposeful, planning to see someone or explore somewhere special
notes: When visiting a person, always use the personal 'a' before them: 'Visité a mis padres' (I visited my parents). With places, no preposition is used: 'Visité el museo'.
